# SiteDetailPage6: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on pages of this type that a visitor can use (links are in
GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. To use one, paste its line into `SiteDetail6Elements`, in the **elements**
YOURS block (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in
controls/Everywhere.md. Not listed: anything that appears only after a click, behind a login, or
after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.
